{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify valid completed orders: status is 'completed', revenue is not null and greater than 0
valid_completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                                  (sales_df['revenue'].notnull()) & 
                                  (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Count the number of valid completed orders
valid_completed_count = len(valid_completed_orders)
valid_completed_count"}
